id.description: The stable identifier for the property record.

ownerEname.description: The W3DS eName of the person or group that owns this property record.

name.description: A human-readable name for the property.

location.description: The location label for the property, which may be less specific than its postal address.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone used for the property’s operational dates.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code used for the property’s operating records.

createdAt.description: When the property record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the property record was last changed.

isArchived.description: Whether the property has been archived from active operations.
